compiled_state.title: Add shared _emit_conflict_data helper to merge-helpers.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD8 (foundation): script emits CONFLICT_DATA output with the same schema as merge-to-main-direct.sh on merge conflict — this task introduces the shared helper used by both modes.

## Description
Add a shared helper `_emit_conflict_data <branch> <base_branch> <resolution_strategy>` to `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh`. The helper computes the conflicted-files list (use existing `ms_get_conflicted_files` if present; fallback `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`) and prints a single line of the form:

```
CONFLICT_DATA {"branch":"...","base_branch":"...","conflicted_files":[...],"resolution_strategy":"..."}
```

Then update `_phase_merge` in `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh` to call this helper before each `exit 1` in the merge-failure path with `resolution_strategy="git-merge-no-ff"`. This turns the T1 test `test_conflict_data_schema_direct` GREEN and produces a reusable contract for the PR script (Task 2+).

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh (modify — add helper)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh (modify — call helper from merge-failure path)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Helper emits all four schema keys
  Verify: bash -c 'source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh; declare -f _emit_conflict_data >/dev/null'
- [ ] Direct-mode CONFLICT_DATA test now passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "test_conflict_data_schema_direct.*PASS"
- [ ] Existing direct-mode dispatcher tests still pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
